name: sharespace
description: ShareSpace — Plan together. Split fairly. Stay organized.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @sharespace/server" "npm run dev --workspace @sharespace/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck --workspace @sharespace/core && npm run build --workspace @sharespace/server && npm run build --workspace @sharespace/web
